attributes.title: 2027 Collaborative Perspectives on Addiction Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Society of Addiction Psychology, Division 50 of the American Psychological Association, holds its 2027 Collaborative Perspectives on Addiction meeting from Wednesday, April 28, to Saturday, May 1, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency La Jolla in San Diego. The theme, "Bridging Science and Practice: 15 Years of Interdisciplinary Addiction Research," marks the meeting's fifteenth year.

CPA is a mid-sized meeting where addiction researchers, clinicians and trainees share symposia and posters on substance use, treatment and recovery. New for 2027 is a preconference workshop on April 28. Proposals for symposia and posters get priority consideration if submitted by December 1, 2026, and late-breaking posters will be considered in January 2027.

The society says continuing education credits are a large part of CPA and will be offered for all accepted symposia, with credits handled through the CE GO platform. The number of hours and the approving body had not been posted when we checked, so psychologists and counselors should confirm credit details before registering.

Registration prices depend on career stage and Division 50 membership. Members pay $385 at the early price and $435 at the late price, non-members $460 or $510, and student members $210 or $260; early-career and single-day tickets are also sold. The page does not say when the early price ends. Continuing education credits and the preconference workshop cost extra.
